_comment: Numerical source for the clinician cohort chart in guides/al-amyloidosis-kidneys.html. The chart and the static table must both match this file (checked by tests/al-amyloidosis-tools.cjs). Values verified against the PubMed abstract (PMID 42498058) on 2026-11-06; per-score group sizes and the competing-risk hazard ratio are intentionally null until checked against the full text.

source.citation: Rauf, M. U., et al. (2026). Evaluation of CD68+ macrophages in relation to kidney outcomes in immunoglobulin light-chain amyloidosis. Kidney International, 110(5), 1283-1293.
source.design: Retrospective single-center cohort (UK National Amyloidosis Centre), observational

population: Consecutive patients with kidney AL amyloidosis treated 2000-2022 who achieved a deep and sustained hematologic response to chemotherapy

sap_landmark.landmark: Serial SAP scintigraphy at diagnosis and at 2 years; outcome counted from the 2-year landmark
sap_landmark.note: Conditional hazard ratio among patients alive and RRT-free at 2 years with serial scans; not an absolute risk and not part of the bar chart.
